ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious JavaScript Execution Via Mshta.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of javascript code using "mshta.exe".

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "MSHTA\.EXE") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*javascript.*"))
